correctness.rationale: Over any commutative characteristic-two coefficient algebra, squaring the proposed images of x and y leaves only c² and e². Reduction modulo the nilpotent ideal (c,e) makes the linear endomorphism block triangular with determinant Δ², so its invertibility is equivalent to Δ being a unit before or after reduction. The nilpotent factor has length four; the smooth factor has dimension six and there are eight tangent directions. On field points the quotient matrix has blocks (B,0;w,det B). Every projective line stabilizer has such a representative, by scaling (B,0;w,δ) by δ/det B. At the identity the induced matrix has free off-diagonal coefficients and diagonal (b,g,b+g); it is every traceless matrix, and trace splits off scalars since 3 is a unit. The subgroup wording is also justified: in projective invertible matrices the scheme image is cut out by M13²=M23²=0. On this closed subscheme the upper-left block B is invertible locally; solve B(e,c)^T=(M13,M23)^T and normalize the projective matrix by its Schur complement divided by det B. This inverts the action map and works over arbitrary k. The checker was inspected, not run; the general argument does not rest on its finite-field samples.
